column1: # Eukore's supergroups and groups (eukore/groups.py; since 2026-11-07, format 5): a species takes the row of its most
# specific NCBI clade below. supergroup: the deep lineages of Burki et al. 2020 (Trends Ecol Evol 35:43) and UniEuk,
# as EukProt v3 names them (Obazoa, Amoebozoa, Archaeplastida, TSAR, Haptista, Cryptista, Discoba, Metamonada, CRuMs,
# Ancyromonadida, Malawimonadida, Hemimastigophora, Provora; incertae sedis: none of them). NCBI has no node for Obazoa,
# Archaeplastida or Cryptista: their clades are listed one by one. group: the finer level busco/loci.tsv's call rates
# and the benchmarks use, which keeps the names of Eukore's groups before format 5 where they still fit (SAR is split
# into its Stramenopiles, Alveolata, Rhizaria and Telonemia; Haptista into its Haptophyta and Centroplasthelida).
# taxids of NCBI's taxdump of 2026-11; groups.py checks each name against the build's taxdump.
